'''Success Through Charismatic Influence''' was the name given to a training regimen that was hosted on the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. [[Joram Kithe]] attended the seminar prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
